Main entry point.description: A main that returns an int exit code

ORM Model.description: A model. Its table is created at startup; field types are string, int, float or bool.

HTTP Route.description: A route handler. Return ok/err, a string, or an object literal.

Result error.description: Return a failed result from a handler

Object literal.description: A value, not text. Fields may be string, int, float, bool or another object.

Raw string.description: A triple-quoted string with no escape processing; ${holes} still interpolate

Match.description: One arm of a match. An arm is Variant(binding) => { ... }; name a real variant of the union or result you are matching.

Standard library import.description: A std import. It resolves against the compiler binary's directory, its parent, then the working directory.
